confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates from general knowledge of Amsterdam pricing, not live listings. Restaurant and beer anchors are moderately reliable. Hotel and hostel anchors are less certain because July is peak season and rates vary widely by district and booking lead time. Cocktail and wine are estimated from typical Amsterdam bar and restaurant pricing relative to beer. The FX observation came from search-result summaries and a secondary site that reproduces RBA data; I did not open the RBA page directly, so it should be verified against the F11.1 table.
comparable_city_reasoning: Benchmarked against major Western European capitals with similar café, restaurant and tourist-accommodation pricing (for example Brussels, Copenhagen and Paris for food and drink), adjusted upward for Amsterdam's high summer hotel and hostel demand and its comparatively expensive central accommodation.
